'''''Cryptologia''''' is a journal in [[cryptography]] published six times per year since January 1977. Its remit is all aspects of cryptography, with a special emphasis on [[History of cryptography|historical aspects of the subject]]. The founding editors were Brian J. Winkel, [[David Kahn (writer)|David Kahn]], Louis Kruh, Cipher A. Deavours and Greg Mellen.<ref name="editors">{{cite web |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/ucry20 |title=Cryptologia |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website= |publisher=[[Taylor & Francis]] |access-date= 4 May 2024|quote=}}</ref> The current Editor-in-Chief is Craig Bauer.

The journal was initially published at the [[Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology]]. In July 1995, it moved to the [[United States Military Academy]], and was then published by [[Taylor & Francis]] since the January 2006 issue (Volume 30, Number 1).<ref>Brian J. Winkel, Letter From the Editor, ''Cryptologia'' 29(4), October 2005</ref>
